$comment: Upstream source of truth for QA scenario DEFINITIONS only — results, owners, and defect links live in the Google Sheet and per-run artifacts, never here. Active tabs merged in v2: the installed-PWA iOS/Android tabs became one 'PWA' tab (device-specific rows keep their [iOS]/[Android] scenario prefix and MUST carry requiresProduction or requiresDevice), and 'Cross Surface' dissolved into concrete per-surface rows. Retired cases keep their historical tab and are never deleted; IDs are never reused. requiresProduction = cannot pass on localhost; requiresDevice = needs a real installed device; the 'tx' tag marks rows whose walk involves real wallet transactions.

Cancel one with a reason; pause and resume
Close, archive, reopen
cases.expected: Wizards pin documents before any chain write and name failures; cancel/pause/close/archive state their blast radius and require reasons where designed; resume clears the pause cleanly

cases.scenario: Endowment operations: vault deposit with limits, withdraw, harvest & distribute, emergency pause, auto-allocate
steps: Deposit into the vault respecting min/refusals
Withdraw with share preview
Harvest & distribute; note the split report
Check pause/auto-allocate gates
cases.expected: Deposit honors min/refusal reasons; withdraw previews shares; harvest reports its split outcome honestly incl. the unverified-split case; pause and auto-allocate respect their narrow owner gates

cases.scenario: Cookie jar payouts: deposit, withdraw with purpose within limits and cooldown
steps: Deposit into the payouts jar
Withdraw with purpose within limits
Hit the cooldown and read the error
cases.expected: Deposit approves+deposits; withdraw requires purpose, respects maxWithdrawal and cooldown with clear errors; balances visibly update afterward

cases.scenario: Commitment inspector steward acts: confirm ordinary/fallback, raise & resolve dispute, expire, recovery overrides
steps: Confirm a commitment ordinarily and via fallback
Raise and resolve a dispute per outcome
Expire one; use recovery acts with reasons
cases.expected: Ordinary confirms queue offline; reasoned acts require connection+reason; dispute freezes and each resolve outcome lands correctly; recovery acts (count work, mark ready, attach assessment, cancel) record their reasons

cases.scenario: Seed a commitment: 4-step wizard, named confirmers, review, queued creation
steps: Run the 4-step seed wizard
Add named confirmers incl. one bad address
Review, queue, and watch the queued row
cases.expected: Beats validate; a bad/duplicate confirmer address is rejected visibly (currently a silent no-op); review precedes queueing; the queued row appears before the indexer catches up

cases.scenario: Coordination: create signal pools, manage strategies, register/deregister items, allocate weights
steps: Create a signal pool
Add/remove strategies; register and deregister items
Allocate weights and save
cases.expected: One-shot pool creation disappears after success; strategy add/remove rewrites the list with confirms; register validates ids; weight allocation persists

cases.scenario: Hypercert marketplace: approvals gate, list for yield, cancel listing — including whether it's reachable at all
steps: Open the hypercert marketplace panel (note if unreachable)
Complete approvals; list for yield
Cancel the listing
cases.expected: The approvals gate unlocks listing; listing walks its signing steps honestly; cancel works (currently a bare unguarded button, and the whole panel may be dead due to a hardcoded permission — reachability is part of the test)

cases.scenario: Global chrome: garden switch chip, command palette (⌘K), notifications sheet, view-public
steps: Switch gardens via the chip and watch every workspace re-scope
Run quick actions from ⌘K
Open notifications; open view-public
cases.expected: Switching gardens re-scopes every workspace and syncs the URL; palette finds pages/gardens/actions and runs quick actions; notifications render (no mark-as-read exists); view-public opens the public page

cases.scenario: Admin submit-work wizard with review-step edit jumps and offline queueing
steps: Run the admin submit-work wizard
Use review-step Edit jumps
Submit once offline and read the queue toast
cases.expected: Four steps complete; review's per-section Edit returns to the right step; offline submission queues with an honest toast

cases.scenario: Hub queue at volume: full scroll, search/sort, deep item open and return
steps: Open the fullest garden's queue
Scroll fully; search and sort
Open a deep item and return; check scroll position
cases.expected: On the fullest garden the queue scrolls without jank, search narrows with a live count, and returning from a deep item preserves scroll position

cases.scenario: Data-source failure on the hub: throttle/offline the network and load
steps: Throttle or kill the network in devtools
Load the hub; read the error state
Restore and retry
cases.expected: The canvas shows an honest error/retry state — never a blank shell — and recovers on retry once the network returns

cases.scenario: Open a field-note record: media mosaic, lightbox, feedback, attestation link

Open the lightbox from the mosaic; check index and Escape order

cases.expected: Tile opens the record dialog; mosaic images open the lightbox at the right index and Escape closes only the lightbox first; empty feedback shows the italic placeholder; 'View attestation' opens the EAS explorer; closing returns focus to the opening tile

cases.scenario: Boot performance: warm reload locally; cold-start budget on a production build
preconditions: For the cold measurement: a hosted origin, or a local production build (in packages/client: bun run build, then bun run preview)
steps: Local dev:prod: warm-reload the app and confirm fast interactive with no re-optimization reload loop
Local dev:prod: note (but do not fail on) cold-transform watchdog trips — reproduce warm before judging
Production build or hosted origin: clear caches, cold-start, and time to interactive against the watchdog budget
cases.expected: Local dev:prod: warm reloads are fast and no dependency re-optimization reload loop appears — a cold Vite transform tripping the boot watchdog locally is an environment artifact, never a defect. Hosted/production build: a cleared-cache cold start stays under the boot watchdog threshold and never shows the recovery screen
